data.name: The Grand Hybrid Hotel
data.description: The ceiling coves featured curved architectural mouldings with radii as tight as 80 mm, making rigid linear fixtures impossible. The client also demanded Ra≥95 colour rendering to make the Calacatta marble and rose gold finishes read accurately under both day and night conditions, with DALI scene control across the lobby, bar and corridor zones.
data.longDescription: The Grand Hybrid Hotel is a newly renovated luxury property in central Vienna. The design team, led by a Munich-based studio, specified a lighting scheme that would honour the building's 19th-century neoclassical bones while introducing a thoroughly modern, intimate atmosphere. Light needed to feel continuous, unbroken by fixture housings, and true to the warm marbles and brass accents used throughout the public areas.

features.title: The Challenge
features.description: The ceiling coves featured curved architectural mouldings with radii as tight as 80 mm, making rigid linear fixtures impossible. The client also demanded Ra≥95 colour rendering to make the Calacatta marble and rose gold finishes read accurately under both day and night conditions, with DALI scene control across the lobby, bar and corridor zones.

features.title: Our Solution
features.description: We supplied over 680 metres of CobFlex 528-HCRI (Ra>97, 2700K, 24V) mounted in slim, extruded aluminium profiles with curved corners custom bent on-site. A companion run of CobFlex 480-24V at 3000K handled corridor wallwashing. All zones are driven by DALI-2 power supplies with 0.1–100% dimming and four programmed scenes (Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Night).

data.name: Maison Velle Flagship
data.description: Off-the-shelf shelf lighting failed on two counts — colour consistency across the 22-metre run was visibly patchy, and the CRI of Ra 80 made deep burgundy and forest-green garments appear flat. The fittings also needed to disappear into a 12 mm shadow gap on each shelf, leaving no visual clutter.
data.longDescription: Maison Velle commissioned a complete refit of their Paris flagship, moving away from spot-heavy lighting to a calmer, more gallery-like presentation. The visual merchandising team required a light source that would read silks, cashmeres and printed fabrics identically under both electric light and the daylight flooding in from the street-facing vitrine.

features.title: The Challenge
features.description: Off-the-shelf shelf lighting failed on two counts — colour consistency across the 22-metre run was visibly patchy, and the CRI of Ra 80 made deep burgundy and forest-green garments appear flat. The fittings also needed to disappear into a 12 mm shadow gap on each shelf, leaving no visual clutter.

features.title: Our Solution
features.description: CobFlex 528-HCRI (Ra>97, R9>90, 3-step MacAdam at 3500K) was specified in a miniature 8 mm aluminium extrusion recessed into the shelf shadow gap, paired with a micro-lens diffuser to soften the cut-off and avoid fabric glare. A 24V constant-voltage topology with remote drivers kept the shelf section under 14 mm thick.

EngineeringSupport.title: Talk to our engineering team.
EngineeringSupport.description: Share your project requirements — voltage, length, IP rating, mounting profile and dimming protocol. A lighting application engineer will return a specification, photometric files and a reel-count calculation within one working day.

Technology.title: Engineered for the professionals who specify light.
Technology.description: CobFlex strips are engineered for lighting designers, specifiers and contractors who demand photometric precision, long-term reliability and consistent quality across projects. Every meter is binned, tested and documented to the standards expected of professional architectural lighting.

Technology.title: Designed for the way professionals specify linear light.
Technology.description: Four engineering disciplines define every CobFlex strip — from the chip architecture up to the photometric documentation that ships with every reel.

feature.title: Chip-on-Board Architecture
feature.description: A contiguous COB phosphor layer eliminates the discrete LED dot matrix. With 320–840 chips per meter and a uniform emitting surface, CobFlex delivers pixel-free linear light without deep diffusers.

feature.title: Thermal Engineering
feature.description: Double-layer 3 oz rolled-annealed copper FPC (105 µm) and aluminum-core PCB options keep Tc ≤ 85 °C at rated current for consistent lumen maintenance at L70 / 50,000 h.

feature.title: Colorimetric Consistency
feature.description: Every production lot is measured on a calibrated spectrophotometer and binned to within a 3-step MacAdam ellipse (≤3 SDCM). Reels carry CCT, CRI and (x,y) chromaticity coordinates on the label.

feature.title: Mechanical Reliability
feature.description: IP68 variants use PU-silicone co-extrusion tested to 50,000 flex cycles down to 25 mm radius, with marine-grade tinned-copper lead wires and silicone strain reliefs for continuous flex installations.

IPRatings.title: IP Ratings & Sealing
IPRatings.description: Choose the ingress protection matched to your installation environment. Every sealed variant carries documented IP test reports available on request.

info.name: IP20
info.title: Bare PCB — Indoor Dry
info.description: For recessed aluminum profiles with integrated diffusers, coves, display cases and furniture. Must be mounted in a sealed profile.

info.name: IP65
info.title: Silicone Coated — Splash
info.description: Kitchens, bathrooms (zone 2), retail window displays and hospitality environments exposed to dust, condensation or occasional cleaning splash.

info.name: IP67
info.title: Silicone Tube — Wet Location
info.description: Building facades under eaves, landscape and pool surrounds, walk-over profiles and temporary outdoor installations subject to temporary immersion.

info.name: IP68
info.title: PU-Silicone Co-extrusion — Submersible
info.description: Fountains, pools, underwater linear effects, marine exterior and cold-storage environments. Tested to 10 m, 72 h continuous immersion.

Manufacturing.title: Manufacturing & Quality Control
Manufacturing.description: Six production stages — every reel is electrically, photometrically and visually inspected before shipment.

feature.title: SMT Die Bonding
feature.description: High-precision pick-and-place mounts 320–840 flip-chip COB dies per meter on 3 oz RA copper FPC, with SAC305 lead-free reflow soldering at 245 °C peak.

feature.title: Phosphor Dispensing
feature.description: Proprietary phosphor-silicone matrix is precision-dispensed over the die array and cured in a nitrogen-purged oven to ensure uniform CCT and CRI across the reel.

feature.title: Encapsulation
feature.description: For IP65/67/68 SKUs, extruded silicone or PU-silicone layers are applied in-line; IP68 co-extrusion creates a single monolithic sleeve with no glued end caps.

feature.title: In-line Testing
feature.description: Every meter is probed for Vf, current draw and luminous flux at 24 V; colorimetric measurements are taken every 5 m on an integrating sphere.

feature.title: Burn-in
feature.description: 100% of reels undergo a 4-hour powered burn-in at 45 °C ambient; any Vf drift or dead pixel triggers automatic rejection.

feature.title: Documentation
feature.description: Every reel is labelled with CCT, CRI, Vf, bin code, production date and QR traceability; a per-lot photometric test report is available for specification-grade projects.

Photometric.title: Photometric Performance
Photometric.description: Optical consistency is measured, not assumed. Every CobFlex lot ships with photometric data that can be dropped directly into lighting simulation software.

feature.title: Beam Angle Control
feature.description: In 10° increments from 10° to 120° via matched silicone-extruded lenses, with beam-angle tolerance ± 3° across a 5 m reel and between production lots.

feature.title: Color Consistency ≤3 SDCM
feature.description: Within-reel and between-reel color held within a 3-step MacAdam ellipse; multi-reel projects can be ordered from a single production batch for tighter tolerance.

feature.title: Flicker-free Dimming
feature.description: All CobFlex SKUs dim to 0.1% with recommended constant-voltage / constant-current drivers; compatibility with TRIAC, 0-10 V, DALI-2 and DMX decoders documented per driver.

Materials.title: Materials & Construction
Materials.description: Premium materials specified for thermal performance, optical clarity and long-term UV stability in demanding environments.

Electrical_Mechanical.title: Specification reference.
Electrical_Mechanical.description: Consolidated baseline specifications across the CobFlex platform. Consult individual product datasheets for SKU-specific values.

feature.title: How do I choose between IP20, IP65, IP67 and IP68?
feature.description: IP20 for indoor profile mounting where the profile itself provides dust / moisture protection. IP65 for dust and splash (kitchens, bathrooms zone 2, display cases). IP67 for temporary immersion or outdoor under-eaves facade lighting. IP68 for continuous immersion (fountains, pools), marine and cold-storage environments. When in doubt, specify IP67 as a robust all-round outdoor grade.

feature.title: What is the maximum run length from a single feed?
feature.description: For 24 V DC 10 mm PCB SKUs, a single-ended feed supports 5 m without measurable voltage-drop color shift; for runs longer than 5 m, use 20 AWG auxiliary feed wires every 5 m or center-feed the run. Our engineering team can provide voltage-drop calculations for specific SKUs and run lengths.

feature.title: Do you provide IES / LDT photometric files?
feature.description: Yes. Standard IES files are available for every density / CCT / optic combination on request, and we generate project-specific files from goniophotometer measurements when supplied with mounting profile drawings. DIALux / Relux plug-in files and Revit families are also available.

feature.title: Can CobFlex strips be dimmed with TRIAC / DALI / DMX systems?
feature.description: The strips themselves are passive 24 V DC loads; dimming performance depends on the driver / decoder. We publish a compatibility list of recommended TRIAC, 0-10 V, DALI-2, DMX and Casambi decoders, with recommended PWM frequency (>= 2000 Hz) to ensure flicker-free operation for filming environments.

feature.title: What is the warranty period?
feature.description: Standard 3-year warranty on all SKUs, extendable to 5 years for projects using recommended drivers and operating within published thermal limits. Warranty covers lumen maintenance above L70 and color shift within 5 SDCM over the rated lifetime.

feature.title: Are custom CCTs or custom PCB widths available?
feature.description: Yes. Custom CCTs (2000–10000 K), high-CRI formularies (Ra 98, R9 > 90), specialty colors (RGB, RGBW, RGBCCT, dim-to-warm) and custom PCB widths (5–20 mm) are available on MOQ. Lead time is typically 3–4 weeks for custom production.

Certifications.description: All SKUs are tested and certified for EU, UK and North American markets. Project-specific declarations (DoC, LM-80, BIM) are available from the technical support team.

Certifications.title: CE Marked

Certifications.name: UKCA
Certifications.title: UKCA Certified
Certifications.description: UK Conformity Assessed marking for placement on the GB market, covering equivalent UK safety and EMC standards.

Certifications.name: RoHS
Certifications.title: RoHS 2 / REACH
Certifications.description: All materials compliant with RoHS 2 (2011/65/EU amend. 2015/863) and REACH SVHC candidate list (223 substances).

Certifications.name: UL
Certifications.title: UL Recognized
Certifications.description: UL 2108 / UL 879 listed for low-voltage lighting systems, suitable for installation in NEC-compliant projects in North America.

Certifications.name: LM-80
Certifications.title: LM-80 / TM-21
Certifications.description: LED packages tested per IES LM-80-20; L70 lifetime projections per IES TM-21-19 (50,000 h at Tc 85°C).

Certifications.name: IES
Certifications.title: IES Files Available
Certifications.description: Photometric IES / LDT files generated per product from goniophotometer measurements for every density / CCT / optic combination.

Certifications.name: BIM
Certifications.title: BIM Families
Certifications.description: Revit families and DIALux / Relux plug-in files available for download for use in specification-stage lighting layouts.

SeriesComparison.description: Quick reference for specifiers selecting the right CobFlex platform for a project.

Downloads.title: Documents & technical resources.
Downloads.description: Download datasheets, photometric files, installation guides and compliance documents. Project-specific documents (BIM, LM-80, DoC) are available on request.

EngineeringSupport.title: Talk to our engineering team.
EngineeringSupport.description: Share your project requirements — voltage, length, IP rating, mounting profile and dimming protocol. A lighting application engineer will return a specification, photometric files and a reel-count calculation within one working day.

Technology.title: Engineered for the professionals who specify light.
Technology.description: CobFlex strips are engineered for lighting designers, specifiers and contractors who demand photometric precision, long-term reliability and consistent quality across projects. Every meter is binned, tested and documented to the standards expected of professional architectural lighting.

Technology.title: Designed for the way professionals specify linear light.
Technology.description: Four engineering disciplines define every CobFlex strip — from the chip architecture up to the photometric documentation that ships with every reel.

feature.title: Chip-on-Board Architecture
feature.description: A contiguous COB phosphor layer eliminates the discrete LED dot matrix. With 320–840 chips per meter and a uniform emitting surface, CobFlex delivers pixel-free linear light without deep diffusers.

feature.title: Thermal Engineering
feature.description: Double-layer 3 oz rolled-annealed copper FPC (105 µm) and aluminum-core PCB options keep Tc ≤ 85 °C at rated current for consistent lumen maintenance at L70 / 50,000 h.

feature.title: Colorimetric Consistency
feature.description: Every production lot is measured on a calibrated spectrophotometer and binned to within a 3-step MacAdam ellipse (≤3 SDCM). Reels carry CCT, CRI and (x,y) chromaticity coordinates on the label.

feature.title: Mechanical Reliability
feature.description: IP68 variants use PU-silicone co-extrusion tested to 50,000 flex cycles down to 25 mm radius, with marine-grade tinned-copper lead wires and silicone strain reliefs for continuous flex installations.
